name: TikTok

counting.notes: CRITICAL API DIVERGENCE: Native app supports 4,000 chars, but TikTok Content Posting API caps captions at 2,200 chars (truncating/rejecting anything 2,201-4,000).

hashtags.excessBehavior: Native app blocks posting on the 6th hashtag ('Maximum 5 hashtags' rollout Jul-Sep 2025).
hashtags.notes: Hard 5-hashtag cap rolled out in 2025. Avoid generic #fyp/#foryou tags.

links.recommendedStrategy: Use bio link or TikTok Shop anchor; raw caption URLs are not clickable.
links.notes: Captions do not linkify external URLs.

organic.label: TikTok Organic (header tabs, caption/audio marquee, right action rail)

ad.label: TikTok Paid In-Feed Ad (CTA bar + lower-right notch)

adStrict.label: TikTok Strict Paid Ad + Interactive Add-on / Long Caption

oauth.gotcha: Access token expires every 24h! Unaudited developer apps are locked to SELF_ONLY private posting. Audio fingerprinting can auto-reject or mute scheduled video content if commercial audio lacks licensing via TikTok's native sound library. TikTok Shop content is algorithmically favored over external link traffic.

sources: TikTok Content Posting API Docs (2200 API caption cap, 4GB video, 35 Photo Mode)
